priorityList: Maintain Garrote and Rupture on all targets by using Crimson Tempest as your AoE builder
Use Crimson Tempest as your AoE builder to spread bleeds, or Cast Fan instead if all targets have bleeds already
Use Kingsbane on cooldown and sync it with Deathmark if it is ready
Use Vanish to re-apply Garrote buffed by Improved Garrote if initial DoTs are close to running out and the pack will live for another 20+ seconds
